Welcome to the space where I care about your pets, their movement, function & well being.

I'm Antoinette, South African Veterinary Nurse & Physio.
Business owner of Healing Hands Pet Physio.

I have extensive experience as a theatre nurse & have assisted with many orthopaedic & spinal surgeries. 

My physio niche lies in recovery programs following surgery & injury, but of course my services are not limited to those patients.
I specialise in a stress-free approach of treatments & come to your home with a mobile service. 
Your pet relaxes in a familiar environment, without the need to get in & out of a car & sit in a waiting room. 

With the one-on-one attention, I can fully assess your pet’s individual needs and prescribe a tailored recovery program.
If you are interested in my services, please pop me an email at hello@healinghandspetphysio.com or a message on Whatsapp 0712269891. 

I hope you find value here, if so, please subscribe.  

~Attention is the most basic form of Love~
